correctness.rationale: For each leaf i the ODE is l_i’=h−l_i; hence leaf-leaf differences decay e^(−t), preserving all leaf orders and the fixed weighted median rank interval endpoints L,U. The hub weighted median under the cited closest-eligible convention is precisely projection of h onto [L,U], even with zero self-weight because h is still an eligible opinion value in the original full n-tuple definition. Thus if h0 is in [L0,U0], h is constant and all leaves approach h0; otherwise the pair (h,L) or (h,U) solves opposite linear flows and approaches their arithmetic midpoint, never crossing during finite time. This proves consensus for every m>=2 and positive hub weight vector. Rational independent calculations for two leaves (0,1), hub 2/5 yield exactly 1/5 for w>1/2, 2/5 at w=1/2, and 7/10 for w<1/2, verifying discontinuity with unchanged positive-edge support. The ODE proof covers arbitrary m and all real initial opinions; checked examples are supplementary.
residual_risks: The closest-admissible tie selection including zero-weight self-opinion is essential, as are star topology and unit leaf->hub weights; other selection conventions and general networks are not covered.
